#### `def generate_shared_aggregator(func, dtype_mapping, is_grouped_kernel, nopython, nogil, parallel)` (Línea 165)
- **Propósito:** Generate a Numba function that loops over the columns 2D object and applies
a 1D numba kernel over each column.

Parameters
----------
func : function
    aggregation function to be applied to each column
dtype_mapping: dict or None
    If not None, maps a dtype to a result dtype.
    Otherwise, will fall back to default mapping.
is_grouped_kernel: bool, default False
    Whether func operates using the group labels (True)
    or using starts/ends arrays

    If true, you also need to pass the number of groups to this function
nopython : bool
    nopython to be passed into numba.jit
nogil : bool
    nogil to be passed into numba.jit
parallel : bool
    parallel to be passed into numba.jit

Returns
-------
Numba function
- **Firma:** `def generate_shared_aggregator(func, dtype_mapping, is_grouped_kernel, nopython, nogil, parallel)`
- **Retorno / Efectos:** Consulta código fuente.
